title: Alec Baldwin on Career Ups and Downs, ‘Rust’ Prosecution’s Toll on His Health and Future Plans: “I Want to Retire”
summary: The Oscar-nominated and Emmy-winning actor says of the 2021 shooting of Halyna Hutchins and the prosecution of him that followed, "It impacted me in every way — financially, career-wise, my wife, my kids, my health. I was so sick … They tried to get me, and they didn't get me, and they cheated and broke the law to get me, and it's just been tough."
